data.body: Merged as ab323f7df0c (Gerrit 3440). Windows sweep run 44456347985 (job 135332660982) ran at ab323f7df0c: 19780 passed, 699 skipped, 10 failed. None of the 10 failures is in `tests/integration/test_cleanup_comment_echo_jira.py` (24 tests, all collected under the sweep's `-m "not integration and not external"`), the 2 tortoise tests, or the new `tests/unit/test_windows_mode_bit_skip.py`, so every line removed from `posix-permissions.args` passed or skipped there (`-q` output lists failures only). The ACL step ran and its `icacls` output is recorded on cloistered-decomposed-nymph. The job concluded `failure` because of other classes: 4 cp1252 failures in tests added by 9d205edbd45 (text-encoding class, since addressed by the merged Gerrit 3430), and follow-ups for the other 3 bugs in this cluster (Gerrit 3443-3445). The `success` criterion waits on the next sweep after those land.
